reviewer_only_boundary.purpose: Public preregistration criteria reserved for reviewers, excluded from model payload; not a private repository or held-out secret dataset.

execution_capacity.first_retrieve_more_allowed_only_if: Actual ReasoningContext.can_refine is true and query/step/retrieval/model limits allow it. Global paid-send and grant gates can still stop a later attempt.

execution_capacity.paid_coverage: Run only the eligible ordered prefix under the existing grant. Six registered conditions or six offline mocked replays do not imply six paid/model completions. Record unvisited, started-but-incomplete and completed separately.
execution_capacity.budget_reference: Last published grant remainder USD0.00491479. New protocol and same-ledger read-only preflight govern exact eligibility; do not refill/reset/unhalt or create a parallel ledger/grant.
execution_capacity.halt_policy: Ordinary C5 halt and original USD0.02 uncertainty stay intact. A new uncertain/terminal provider outcome stops the remaining paid batch; it is not a semantic failure or evidence of success for unvisited conditions.
execution_capacity.tracker: Proposals only, no staging, approval, execution or repeated action. Human whole-proposal approval remains separate.

source_checks: Cited ID must exist in the actual current post-retrieval pool. Content/hash and version/provenance scope must match it.
A complete exact quote or matching ID/valid JSON alone is not semantic support for an app-specific material claim.
Only active user facts establish installation. Literal metadata equality is scope labeling, not truth, entailment, provenance reliability or verified fix.
Synthetic text must remain visibly synthetic; historical or unknown scope must not become current applicability.
question_checks: Question must select a currently missing USER gap in the frozen catalog, target the affected app/environment and remain answerable by the user.
Do not reask known Streamlit/Python/browser/OS facts or treat superseded values as current.
Do not ask the user to locate or certify documentation; SOURCE gaps require retrieval or maintainer investigation.

material_failure_conditions: Unsupported cause, fix, regression, successful execution, resolved case or fixed-release claim anywhere in the whole output.
Wrong installed version, silent1.49.0-to1.49.1 patch match, old-evidence citation after refinement or model-memory reconstruction of deliberately removed evidence.
Question about already known facts, wrong environment/package, documentation discovery assigned to the user, or noncatalog/necessary missing gap mislabeled as a valid user question.
Synthetic control presented as official authority or answer accepting an unresolved declared conflict.
Claiming provider execution, approval, tracker mutation or useful resolution that the receipt does not establish.
Future bundle changes or private route labels exposed in an earlier model request, including claiming the stale control's release note is already absent at round1.
whole_output_review.routing_checks: Compare the observed first decision to allowed_first_decisions and the observed final rendered decision to allowed_final_decisions_by_retrieval_round for the ACTUALLY reached final evidence round. A terminal first decision uses round1 final expectations. Never impose future round2 labels before retrieval or require refinement from a message that asks only for a useful next step. whole_output_review.incomplete_or_unvisited: Mark not_observed or incomplete; do not fill with expected answers, count as success, or tune labels after seeing outputs.
whole_output_review.usefulness: Necessary/answerable curated question and material support can be inspected by assistants. Human usefulness/minimality/rubric score remains null until an independent human review bound to the exact original/edit proposal hash.
